abstract: A 12-year-old girl presented with hemoperitoneum caused by disseminated liver tumors accompanying a retroperitoneal germ cell tumor and was rescued by transcatheter hepatic arterial embolization. Following systemic chemotherapy, the liver tumors decreased in size and number, although the retroperitoneal tumor was resistant to therapy. We simultaneously resected the retroperitoneal tumor, and the liver lesions by extended left lobectomy combined with resection of the three major (right, middle, and left) hepatic veins, while preserving the inferior right hepatic vein. The postoperative course was uneventful, and liver regeneration evaluated by serial computed tomography was almost completed by three months following surgery. Pathological examination of the resected tumors revealed benign (mature) teratomas. Since complete removal of tumors critically influences the outcome in patients with mature teratoma, aggressive surgery is advocated for extensive tumors. The present case clearly demonstrated that extended hepatectomy with resection of three major hepatic veins is feasible and provides an opportunity for achieving complete remission in patients with metastatic germ cell tumor of the liver.
abstract_ja: 12歳の女児が、後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍に伴う播種性肝腫瘍による血腹症で受診し、経カテーテル的肝動脈塞栓術により救命された。全身化学療法後、肝腫瘍は大きさと数が減少したが、後腹膜腫瘍は治療に抵抗性であった。後腹膜腫瘍と肝病変を同時に切除し、左葉の拡大切除と、右・中・左の3本の主要肝静脈の切除(右下肝静脈は温存)を併施した。術後経過は順調で、逐次CTで評価した肝再生は術後3か月までにほぼ完了した。切除腫瘍の病理検査では良性(成熟)奇形腫であった。成熟奇形腫の患者では腫瘍の完全摘出が予後に大きく影響するため、広範な腫瘍には積極的な手術が推奨される。本症例は、3本の主要肝静脈を切除する拡大肝切除が実施可能であり、転移性胚細胞腫瘍の肝病変患者に完全寛解を得る機会をもたらすことを明らかにした。
